title: Beyond the Veil
description: The tear opened over the shrine at the Crossroads, where every caravan between Dalhurst and Millbrook stops to water its horses. Two guards off the last wagon through are already gone. Seal it before the next one comes down that road blind.

objectives.description: See what is coming through at the Crossroads
Take five binding reagents off the things coming through
objectives.notes: Dropped by planar entities emerging from the breach

objectives.description: Clear ten planar entities off the road
objectives.notes: Otherworldly creatures immune to normal damage

objectives.description: Charge the four anchor stones around the shrine
objectives.notes: Channel magic into each anchor stone

objectives.description: Hold the ritual until the tear closes
objectives.notes: Long channeling ritual, must survive waves of enemies

objectives.description: Tell Elara the road is a road again

notes: Threat: two named caravan guards missing and the Dalhurst-Millbrook road impassable at the exact point every caravan on it has to cross. Giver motive: keeping the trade roads safe is the Circle's stated purpose and Elara's council standing rides on a fast, visible response. Consequence: every caravan behind the closed road either waits or risks the breach; left alone, the next crossing is blind. Second Adept quest. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
